description: Files a bug report on heistclips' public board (heistclips.com/requests, tagged Bug) and emails the person who fixes it. For something heistclips did that went wrong: a clip with no sound or a black or empty video, a render or export that failed or got stuck, a cut_clip or find_clip_moments error, wrong moments, a post that did not arrive, a broken page. It takes everything already known from the chat, so nobody has to ask again: the stream, the start and end of the moment, which tool or step failed, the exact error text returned, the clip_id and the account code if there are any. title and what_happened are the user's own words, verbatim, in their language. A missing feature is request_a_feature instead. ok true means it was filed.

account.description: The account code (hc_…) if the user has one. Sent to the builder only, never shown on the board.

client.description: Which assistant this is, e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Grok

clip_id.description: clip_id from cut_clip, if the bug is about a clip that was made

contact.description: Optional: email or handle for a reply, verbatim, only if offered. Sent to the builder only.

error_text.description: The exact error text heistclips returned or showed, if any

moment_end.description: End of the moment, seconds into the stream

moment_start.description: Start of the moment, seconds into the stream

source.description: The stream: a Twitch or Kick VOD link or id, or the channel

title.description: What went wrong in a few of the user's own words, under 90 characters, e.g. 'The MP4 has no sound'

tool.description: The tool or step that failed: a tool name like cut_clip or find_clip_moments, or the page step (render, editor, queue, post, checkout)

what_happened.description: What they did and what heistclips did instead, in their words. No links here; the stream goes in source.

name: report_a_bug
title: Report a heistclips bug: something broke or came out wrong
